# HALF 1 – The claim and its reproduction {.darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
First half – about 75 minutes
:::

::: notes
The first half. We start with the vocabulary of three kinds of repetition, and with the large studies that measured how often findings survive each of them, one of which supplies our case. Then the case itself, an experiment run by email, and its claim. We work out what question the claim answers and draw a causal graph of the experiment, which turns up something that is easy to miss. And before the break you reproduce the result that one of the five independent analysts of this claim reported, whichever of them you choose, and find out why your number is exactly that number.
:::
